Summary: Inventory all remotes across the four clusters
Description: Enumerate every remote configured on each local cluster (dev/qa/prod/ccs) via GET /_remote/info. Record cluster -> remote -> num_nodes_connected, mode, initial_connect_timeout, skip_unavailable. Acceptance: reviewed inventory table covering all four clusters.
Agree expected num_nodes_connected and expected mode per remote; no uniformity assumed. Acceptance: es_clusters.json populated and signed off.
Decide Warning vs Critical per environment; missing remote and unreachable cluster = Critical. Acceptance: documented severity matrix per environment.
Record skip_unavailable per remote; annotate silent-degradation risk. Acceptance: captured per remote with risk notes.
Define verdict doc schema (timestamp, cluster, remote, connected, nodes expected/actual, mode, skip_unavailable, severity, reason). Acceptance: schema documented and reviewed.

Load inventory + credentials from file, call GET /_remote/info per cluster, evaluate vs baseline, classify severity, print to screen (no indexing). Acceptance: runs against all four clusters with correct verdicts and edge cases handled.
Read API keys from a git-ignored credentials file with committed example template; isolate auth behind one function. Acceptance: creds from file, no real secrets committed.

Summary: Refactor credential loading to AWS Secrets Manager
Description: Replace file loading with boto3 Secrets Manager retrieval behind the same interface. Acceptance: runtime Secrets Manager auth, no static key files in deploy path.

Summary: Provision least-privilege service account / API key
Description: Create key with cluster monitor privilege + write to ccs-health-monitor only. Acceptance: key scoped and validated in non-prod.
Phase 1
column9: Add timeouts, per-cluster isolation, FedRAMP TLS cert verification (CA bundle), structured logging. Acceptance: induced failures produce Critical for affected cluster only.

Summary: Create ccs-health-monitor index with explicit mapping
Description: Create the visible (non dot-prefixed) state index with the Phase 0 mapping. Acceptance: verdict docs index cleanly.
Apply retention per agreed period. Acceptance: old verdicts age out automatically.

Summary: Wire collector to write verdicts to state store
Description: Enable indexing path (one verdict doc per remote per cycle). Acceptance: verdicts land, queryable, one doc per remote per cycle.

Summary: Confirm read access to the state store for alerting role
Description: Ensure the Kibana alerting role reads ccs-health-monitor. The index is visible, so no allow_restricted_indices grant is needed. Acceptance: alerting role queries successfully.

Summary: Kibana ES Query rule - Critical tier (per remote)
Description: Per-remote-grouped critical rule (connected false / missing remote / unreachable cluster). Acceptance: induced non-prod critical fires for failing remote.

Summary: Kibana ES Query rule - Warning tier (per remote)
Description: Per-remote warning rule (partial pool / mode drift), distinct from critical. Acceptance: partial pool fires warning not critical.

Summary: SMTP connector + templated messages naming failing remote
Description: Reuse Kibana SMTP connector; template messages to name failing remote+cluster. Acceptance: email identifies exact remote and severity.
Configure recovery notifications so alerts auto-resolve when state clears. Acceptance: clearing triggers recovery notification.
Alert when no verdict docs land in a defined window. Acceptance: stopping collector fires staleness alert within window.
Schedule at chosen interval; alert window wider than interval to absorb jitter. Acceptance: unattended scheduled runs, no false flaps.
Add logrotate config and per-severity runbooks. Acceptance: logs rotate; runbook linked from alerts.
Run in non-prod sustained; confirm no false flaps and correct recovery. Acceptance: clean sustained run, sign-off for prod.
